title: Spacious Apt for 4 - Near Nash DT
description:
Unwind in Style – Just 8 Minutes from Downtown Nashville
Discover your perfect Nashville getaway in this modern and stylish studio apartment. Ideally located just minutes from Broadway and the city’s best attractions, it’s the perfect spot to recharge after a day of exploring Music City. Whether you’re enjoying the vibrant nightlife or relaxing with a quiet evening in, this cozy retreat has everything you need to feel at home.

The space
★ LIVING ROOM ★ – Sleeps 2
Relax and recharge in the welcoming living area.
•	Queen Sleeper Sofa (sleeps 2)
•	Smart Flat-Screen TV
•	Coffee Table
 
★ QUEEN BED ★ – Sleeps 2
A restful night awaits in the comfy sleeping space.
•	Queen Bed with Fresh Linens & Pillows
•	Wardrobe with Hangers & Shelves
 
★ KITCHEN & DINING ★
Cook up a homemade meal or enjoy takeout with ease in the fully equipped kitchen. If you want to take a break from the restaurants, then this is the place for you. 
•	Microwave
•	Stove
•	Oven
•	Refrigerator/Freezer
•	Dishwasher
•	Pots & Pans
•	Toaster
•	Sink (Hot & Cold)
•	Cookware, Silverware, Glasses & Trays
 
★ BATHROOM ★
Freshen up in the spacious, well-stocked bathroom.
•	Full Bathtub & Shower
•	Toilet 
•	Fresh Towels
•	Essential Toiletries & Mirror

Guest access
★ EXTRA'S FOR YOU ★
•	High-Speed Wi-Fi
•	Air Conditioning & Heating
•	Ceiling Fan
•	In-Unit Washer/Dryer (in the unit)

This apartment is entirely yours during your stay – relax, unwind, and enjoy!
